_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% 12h base rate over 7 days makes HOLD the skilled call in this coil; the analyst's named breakers (DXY <99.50 + positive funding + CVD >40 for UP; VIX >15 + positive netflow + negative funding for DOWN) have not fired, so conviction sits on patience not direction.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both identify Denial with macro tailwinds building, but analyst explicitly defaults to HOLD with low confidence while narrative implies directional readiness without naming a trigger; the forward phase Disbelief is the analyst's call and is +1 rung legal from Denial.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.005% with DXY breaking below 99.50 and CVD_pct_30d climbing above 40 — signals risk-on conviction breaking the coil upward into Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX sustains above 15 with exchange netflow turning sharply positive (>70) and funding flipping negative — signals risk-off panic overriding the recovery thesis
